chunks.content: RRF (Reciprocal Rank Fusion) combines multiple ranked lists. The k parameter controls the weight of lower-ranked items. A common value is k = 60 which gives reasonable weight to items ranked beyond the top few.

The ingestion pipeline enforces token limits by counting tokens with the embedding model's tokenizer. The target_tokens parameter controls the maximum chunk size, typically set to 300-500 tokens with 10-15% overlap.

The embedder runs on a dedicated thread using std::thread. It receives requests via an mpsc::sync_channel with a bounded buffer of 32. The worker calls the synchronous embed function and sends results back through a oneshot channel.

The reranker model for Phase 6 is bge-reranker-v2-m3, a multilingual cross-encoder based on XLM-RoBERTa-large. It scores (query, chunk) pairs and reranks the fused candidate pool of ~40 down to top 5-8.
Semantic chunking targets 300-500 tokens per chunk with 10-15% overlap. The chunker splits on Markdown headings first, then paragraphs, then sentences. Code blocks and tables are never split mid-way.

MMR (Maximal Marginal Relevance) adds diversity to the reranked results. The mmr_lambda parameter (0.5 default) controls the trade-off between relevance and diversity. Per-source caps (default 2) ensure diverse evidence sources.

The Granite embedding model (ibm-granite/granite-embedding-97m-multilingual-r2) supports 200+ languages with enhanced retrieval for 52 languages. It uses ModernBERT architecture with 384-dimensional CLS pooling output.
